noise_diagnostic.summary_text:
DIAGNOSTIC MULTI-FLUX - Analyse sur 6 flux

Score moyen de proxy de variance: 0.792 (échelle 0-1)
Score maximum: 0.956, Score minimum: 0.737

TOP 3 FLUX AVEC SIGNATURE CSD:
  1. susceptibility (score: 0.956)
     - Q5 ratio: 699.12 vs bruit blanc 0.03
     - Hurst max: 1.038, Pente FFT: -0.390
  2. fliprate (score: 0.788)
     - Q5 ratio: 64.16 vs bruit blanc 0.03
     - Hurst max: 1.146, Pente FFT: -0.467
  3. flip (score: 0.788)
     - Q5 ratio: 64.16 vs bruit blanc 0.03
     - Hurst max: 1.146, Pente FFT: -0.467

BOTTOM 3 FLUX (BRUIT BLANC):
  1. magnetization (score: 0.747)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.945
  2. energy (score: 0.737)
     - Hurst moyen: 1.009
  3. localvar (score: 0.737)
     - Hurst moyen: 1.003
